features.title: Native Performance
features.description: Run at your monitor's native resolution with smooth frame rates and minimal latency.

features.title: Modern Enhancements
features.description: Optional enhancements like widescreen, improved textures, and customizable controls.

features.title: Modding Support
features.description: Active community creating mods, texture packs, and enhancements.

features.title: Cross-Platform
features.description: Play on Windows, macOS, and Linux with full feature parity.

whatWeOffer.title: What We Offer
whatWeOffer.subtitle: Modern features for classic games. Everything you'd expect from a native PC port.

features.title: 4K & Ultrawide
features.description: Renders at any resolution. Ultrawide and multi-monitor fully supported as part of the core renderer.

features.title: Enhanced Framerate
features.description: Play at 60, 120, or fully unlimited FPS. Our frame interpolation generates intermediate frames from actual game state.

features.title: Controller Support
features.description: Full support for Xbox, PlayStation, Switch Pro, and generic controllers. Fully customizable.

features.title: Quality of Life
features.description: Dozens of improvements: graphics settings, HUD options, enhanced camera, and much more.

features.title: Mod Support
features.description: Built-in mod loader with active community creating texture packs and gameplay mods.

features.title: Cross-Platform
features.description: Windows, Linux (including Steam Deck), and macOS supported. Play anywhere.

about.title: About the Project
about.subtitle: Harbour Masters is a community effort bringing N64 classics to PC.

features.title: Faithful to the Original
features.description: The complete N64 experience, faithfully ported to PC with deep respect for the source material.

features.title: Free & Open Source
features.description: Completely free, forever. Built by the community, for the community. Source on GitHub.

features.title: Community Driven
features.description: Built by fans, for fans. Open development with active community input worldwide.

features.title: Modern Compatibility
features.description: Native PC ports rebuilt from scratch. No emulation required. Runs on modern hardware.

community.title: Join the Community
community.subtitle: Connect with 200K+ players from all around the globe. A welcoming community where everyone is valued and respected equally — get support, share mods, and stay up to date.

quickStart.title: Quick Start
quickStart.subtitle: Get playing in 3 simple steps. No experience needed — just download the port(s) you want to play, grab your legally dumped ROM, and start enjoying enhanced features right away.

steps.title: Download a Port
steps.description: Choose your favorite N64 game from our available ports. All are free and open source.

steps.title: Provide Your ROM
steps.description: You'll need your own legally dumped ROM file. We don't distribute any game assets.

steps.title: Play & Enjoy
steps.description: Launch the port, load your ROM, and enjoy enhanced features like 4K, 60fps, and modern controls.

legalNotice.title: Important: We do NOT distribute any game assets
legalNotice.description: Harbour Masters ports are fan-made projects. We do not include, distribute, or host any copyrighted game assets, ROMs, or proprietary Nintendo content. To play, you must bring your own legally dumped ROM from a physical cartridge you personally own. We take legal compliance very seriously.
